paragraphs: Chapter 499
Episode 138: Keeper of the White Night Tower (5)
The day Mary led the Puberty Fleet and arrived to find Tikan, Yona had nowhere to go and immediately returned to the Secret City of Mumei.
She felt regretful and upset that she hadn't been able to take a proper walk with the youngest, and her mood was bad all day. She decided to look at the mission list.

She wanted to clear her thoughts by doing some work. The more difficult and complicated the task, the better the effect, so she only looked at requests classified as highest grade or those she had decided to reject.
One of them was a request from Kinzelo.
The request was to steal an item from the 2nd Tower of Zipfel. Owl had wanted to tear up the request right away.
"He, Mr. Owl. Why don't you take that one?"
"Because it's a perfect job for a shrimp's back to burst."
"Why?"
Owl explained the recent unusual currents between the major forces, international situation, the complex intertwining interests and the position that the secret city should take in such a flow.
"…So I thought it would be better not to take it. Understand?"
"I don't really understand what you're saying when I hear such annoying stories. You just don't want to do it, right?"
"It sounds like that. But at least you're listening, which is much better than when you didn't listen to me at all and suddenly disappeared."
"Hehe, anyway, it seems like a very important job. Why wouldn't our family look for me?"
Owl hid his words and smiled.
"Who knows, whatever the reason, it's better not to be found. Especially in cases like this."
"This was requested by Kinzelo's leader, right?"
Kinzelo's leader.
Ever since Yona became able to control chaos, she had become somewhat interested in him. This was because she knew that he knew 'chaos' well.
"What does that matter?"
"I wanted to meet him once."
"Why?"
"I wanted to ask him a few curious questions."
Owl shrugged his shoulders.
Although he had mentioned the shrimp's back, in fact, Owl was not completely uninterested.
'The item from the 2nd Tower.'
Owl was convinced that the item was a ship's blueprint.
He also knew that Zipfel had deliberately leaked information about the secret construction site in the Sota Desert recently.
From Mumei's perspective, obtaining the blueprint would be an unbeatable card. There was a high possibility that it would become the best means to lead negotiations among the major forces.
'If Yona goes on her own without me, unrelated to the request, it will be difficult for the major forces to hold us responsible.'
In particular, Runcandel would never hold them accountable.
No, beyond that, if Yona were to secure the blueprint, they would rather have to protect and thank Mumei.
Also, from the beginning, Yona wouldn't even leave a trace of entering the 2nd Tower. Her infiltration and assassination abilities had long surpassed Owl's.
'He won't listen even if I stop him... It doesn't seem too bad to let him try just once.'
Without needing to worry any further, Yona had already made her decision.
"I'll take this request."
"You can't."
"I'll go even if you try to stop me, hehe."
"If you must go, there are a few conditions to be met."
In the end, after a non-agreement with Owl, Yona headed for the 2nd Tower.

During the process, Joshua, Diphus, and the youngest also learned that they were involved in this matter, and from that moment on, Yona's top priority was not completing the request, but confirming the life or death of her youngest sibling.
It wasn't just because the youngest, in the middle of Zipfel's sphere of influence, seemed as helpless as a child left alone by the water.
'Wow, is it really okay for something like that to be in the 2nd Tower even though it's not Drakka? Really?'
This was because, while stealing and returning the key from the 2nd Tower, they saw a monster that the siblings could never handle.
This was the background of Yona's arrival at the 2nd Tower.
She had been watching Jin and Murakan from the moment they first entered the underground construction site.
She was also looking for the right moment. A moment when she could approach the youngest while avoiding the surveillance of the Crystal Sphere, Hedo's senses, and Kinzelo's eyes.
In the end, she failed. Even for Yona, not everything was possible.

That's why her appearance now was an unavoidably chosen second-best option. Although it was not the most optimal moment to assassinate the monster Hedo, she felt that if she didn't step up now, the youngest could really lose their life.
Swoosh!
Yona's sword 'Death' and the longsword Bale crossed, leaving a sharp trajectory.
Except for Hedo, who was the target of the assassination, no one realized that Yona had appeared. It was a moment when the transcendence of Hedo's power became even more prominent.
'Yona, sister?'
'Yona!?'

The members of Runcandel all widened their eyes in surprise. Yona's sudden appearance was shocking, but even more surprising was the fact that she had left a long, deep gash on Hedo's chest with a single strike.
Swoosh!
Bright red blood gushed out of Hedo's massive body. It was a much more malicious wound than any of the numerous decisive blows and beatings they had fought for their lives.
On the other hand, Hedo's counterattack only managed to cut off a few strands of Yona's hair, and she had already once again penetrated Hedo's side, thrusting her blade into his side.
Death's blade penetrated Hedo's side by about a hand's width before pulling out.
It was a clear, severe injury. Normally, one would finish their opponent off at this opportunity, but Yona didn't continue attacking and instead created distance.
This was because the extremely limited advantage gained through using the "Silver Dragon's Claw," which Jin had given to the Nameless, had come to an end.
The Nameless assassins have always regarded the Silver Dragon's Claw as a divine tool. By processing it in a unique way, it can stop time for any target for just a blink of an eye.
It was thanks to this divine tool of the Nameless that Yona could cut and stab Hedo's flesh so easily. Of course, her assassination sword was also exceptionally good.
"Little one, ugh!"
"Sister!"
As Yona retreated from Hedo and headed towards Jin, her legs suddenly wobbled. A stream of blood flowed between her lips.

When she cut and stabbed with Death, Hedo's longsword, Bale, didn't directly touch her, but the energy that Hedo exploded with in that moment caused her internal injuries. The aftereffects from the chaos she had caused not long ago hadn't fully subsided yet.
"…It was you!"
The one who stole the blueprint!
Hedo glared with fiery eyes and charged at Yona like a cannonball.
Murakan blocked his path with his breath and dagger, followed by the siblings and Jane standing in Hedo's way.

Despite being injured, Hedo's immense strength remained. He became even more ferocious, like a wounded beast. The sight of him charging without a care, even after taking a direct hit from Murakan's dagger and breath, was enough to leave the party breathless.
However, Hedo was human.
Although he was a 10-star, likely one of the strongest, he wasn't a god. He was enduring the accumulated shocks with sheer willpower.
The Runcandels were aware of this fact.
"We must escape with Sister Yona!"
This was their first and last chance to drive Hedo away.
The entire party had the same thought as Jin.
Even the blueprints were likely in Yona's possession, so if they could just escape safely, this situation would be a victory for the Runcandels.
With a sense of overwhelming pressure like a collapsing mountain, the longsword, Bale, fell upon the heads of the siblings gathered together.
Kuaaa-!
The swordsmen clashing their swords let out a scream.
The Runcandels' ankles were driven into the ground as they blocked Hedo's strike, and the sturdy space that had not collapsed amidst the battle finally crumbled.
The ceiling was also completely destroyed. The shockwave caused by the swords swung by the Runcandels to block the longsword and the surge of Murakan's dagger was to blame.
And so, the entire tower was breaking apart. The Runcandels and Hedo continued their aerial battle, leaping on the falling debris.
Dozens of sword strikes fiercely intertwined in the air every second.
'The wound is deep. A potent poison has seeped in, and it even opens up more with every movement.'
Grinding his teeth, Hedo persisted.
Yona Runcandel was an unexpected variable that Hedo had never anticipated.
If he had known about her existence, he would never have engaged in such a "careless" battle, as Jin had said.
'In the end, I'll have to request assistance from the main force.'
If the Runcandels continued to fight, Hedo was confident he could defeat them all even now.
However, the Runcandels wouldn't be so foolish. Escaping was the obvious course of action.
Therefore, Hedo could no longer turn a blind eye.
Thud!
Among those falling, Hedo was the first to reach the ground.

At the same time, the thick gold ring on his finger began to emit a mysterious light with rune symbols. His ring was an artifact that carried a signal magic similar to the staffs held by tower masters.
The signal was immediately sent to Drakka, the main mountain of Zipfel. Just 3 seconds after the ring emitted light, a large-scale alarm magic was activated in the distance.
'I'm sorry, miss. I can only hope that the 12th generation will be more powerful than the rumors say, enough to survive even the pursuit of the Drakka main force.'
Hedo still didn't want to kill Jin. However, given the current situation, letting the Runcandels go would not only make him suspicious, but also potentially harm Sandra, so he had no choice.
Now there was only one thing left for Hedo to do.
Eliminate the 'witnesses' who saw him promising to spare Jin's life.
Either way, he was planning to leave them to die as a warning to Octavia or to deal with them himself.
The apparition teams were either still falling, completely exhausted, or gasping for breath, stuck in the gaps of the broken tower.
As Hedo raised his head to locate and shoot them, he realized the ceiling of the tower was wide open.
'Why is it wide open when the rooftop was not destroyed?'
Throughout the fight, Hedo had been controlling his energy to ensure the rooftop would remain unharmed even if the rest of the tower was destroyed.
Someone had opened it.
And Hedo had a feeling he knew who it was, which left him with a throbbing headache.
Hedooooooo-!
The owner of this incredibly thunderous, sharp, and irritable voice was none other than Sandra Zipfel.
She had been waiting for Hedo to bring Jin back all along, and when she noticed the activation of the support signal, she broke through the floor to hurl herself into the battlefield.
"You stupid, useless, muscle-headed pig! Are you crazy!? You called the main force!? Do you plan to kill our Jin!?"
Sandra, who had been furiously shouting, soon locked eyes with Jin, who had just landed on the ground, and said:
"Darling! I've been waiting, where are you going without me? Let's go together, together!"
Even in such a desperate situation, hearing Sandra's words gave Jin goosebumps at the back of his neck.
Yet, instinctively,
He felt that she might be of great help in escaping this place.
